confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge; no live listings or booking pages were checked. Restaurant and cafe anchors are moderate confidence; cocktail and wine are inferred from the local beer relationship because direct knowledge is weaker; accommodation is lower confidence given July peak-season variability. Assumes roughly 150 yen per USD. FX value is from search-result summaries citing the RBA exchange-rates table, not a direct page read, and some RBA pages in the results showed earlier dates.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single named comparable city. Regional basis: Kansai heritage cities near Kyoto and Osaka; dining and cafe prices are set against casual Kansai tourist districts, and accommodation is estimated below central Kyoto hotel rates.
